bio: I’m Andry. I build production web platforms for startups and small teams, from auth and APIs to the self-hosted infrastructure under them. Freelance since 2024.
Outside client work I ship my own products, Snug and Animated Fluent Emojis, and contribute to JSON Flow, a VS Code extension with 75,000+ installs.
